teks.Rantai samping yang dicentang boleh bero: Checked side chains may rotate during docking (limited induced fit). Choose 2–6 pocket residues closest to the ligand; with more residues the search space grows quickly and results depend more on exhaustiveness/number of runs. Supported by AutoDock-GPU and Vina (not AutoDock4).
teks.Struktur prediksi AlphaFold untuk protei: AlphaFold predicted structures for proteins without a crystal structure. Type a UniProt accession (e.g. P00918) or a protein/gene name (e.g. ACE2), then Search.
teks.Ujung N/C yang tak beraturan (pLDDT rend: Disordered N/C termini (low pLDDT) can cover the pocket and disturb pocket detection. The protein is colored by pLDDT: dark blue > 90, light blue 70–90, yellow 50–70, orange < 50. Data license CC BY 4.0 — cite Jumper et al. 2021 and Varadi et al. 2024.
teks.AlphaFold: model prediksi tanpa ligan/ko: AlphaFold: predicted model without ligands/cofactors/ions — pocket side chains may differ from the bound form. Check pLDDT in the pocket, consider validation with a reference ligand, and cite the model source in your methods.
teks.Reseptor ini disiapkan dengan versi lama: This receptor was prepared with an older version. Prepare the receptor again (step 1) so flexible residues can be created.

teks.MD air eksplisit (TIP3P, PME) + MM/GBSA: Explicit-water MD (TIP3P, PME) + multi-frame MM/GBSA (needs a GPU; publication standard)
teks.MD pelarut implisit (OBC2) + RMSD/RMSF +: Implicit-solvent MD (OBC2) + RMSD/RMSF + averaged MM/GBSA (tens of minutes to hours)
teks.Minimisasi kompleks + MM/GBSA satu titik: Complex minimization + single-point MM/GBSA (minutes; any laptop)
teks.Penyempurnaan pasca-docking: kompleks di: Post-docking refinement: complexes are minimized or simulated with OpenMM (protein Amber ff14SB, ligand OpenFF Sage 2.3 with NAGL charges equivalent to AM1-BCC). MM/GBSA ΔG is useful for ranking ligands relative to each other (entropy is not computed), not as an absolute affinity.
teks.Pilih ligan di Ringkasan lalu buka tab R: Select a ligand in Summary, then open the RMSD, RMSF, or MM/GBSA over time tab.

teks.Superposisi pada Cα protein frame pertam: Superposed on protein Cα of the first production frame; RMSD > 3 Å = pose drifted

teks.Uji 10–30 detik pada kompleks ligan terp: 10–30 s test on the first selected ligand complex (implicit & explicit)

teks.MM/GBSA: reseptor memuat ion logam (mode: MM/GBSA: the receptor contains metal ions (12-6 nonbonded model) — metal–ligand interaction energies are approximate; compare only ligands with the same metal binding mode.
teks.Minimisasi + MM/GBSA, atau dinamika mole: Minimization + MM/GBSA, or molecular dynamics (OpenMM) in implicit/explicit solvent: RMSD, RMSF, persistent interactions, MM/GBSA ΔG — VirmoDock recommends a level for your laptop
